purpose: Single source of the model-spend caps and price/token assumptions used by load-tests/loadgen.py and experiments/validate_manifests.py

prices_per_million_tokens_usd.generation_source: UNVERIFIED: author's recollection of the list price of Claude Haiku 4.5 (no network in this phase). Deliberately the HIGHER of two figures so that caps are conservative. infra/terraform/INFRA-CONTRACTS.md (Haiku 5.5 section) records 0.11 in / 0.55 out per million for a different model (Haiku 5.5, Standard in-region, us-east-2, file dated 2026-11-23); it does not price Haiku 4.5. Verify against the Bedrock price page before the AWS window.
prices_per_million_tokens_usd.embedding_source: infra/terraform/INFRA-CONTRACTS.md (Titan Text Embeddings V2, $0.00002 per 1K input tokens, recorded there as verified 2026-11-23); not re-verified here

per_request_assumptions.basis: ASSUMPTION. explain counters.modelCalls is 2 in the frozen example (rest-explain.example.json on main); 3 is used as a margin. Token counts are guesses; the loadgen --fetch-explain option records observed model call counts so the next run can replace them.

embedding_experiment_assumptions.basis: ASSUMPTION (tokens per chunk). 10000 x 300 = 3,000K tokens x $0.00002 per 1K = $0.06
